facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/gobjinit:.data
facts.value: The descriptor is copied wholesale by `HSD_GObj_803912E0` into caller-owned storage. During common scene-runtime setup, that copy becomes `gm_80479D48.initdata`; the caller raises `gproc_pri_max` to 0x18, appends SObj callback configuration, installs an additional pointer, and passes the resulting descriptor to `HSD_GObj_80391304`. That initializer adds built-in GObj callbacks, publishes the descriptor globally, and uses its maxima and callback groups to construct the GObj runtime tables.
